lines.en: Hello, Doctor. I think I have a cold.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 선생님. 감기에 걸린 것 같아요.

lines.en: When did it start?
Two days ago. I had a fever last night.
Do you have a cough or a headache?
I have a small cough. My head hurts a little.
lines.ko: 기침이 조금 있어요. 머리도 약간 아파요.

lines.en: Do you feel tired and weak?
Yes, a little. Maybe I need more sleep.
lines.ko: 네, 조금요. 아마 잠이 더 필요한가 봐요.

lines.en: It's a light cold. Don't worry.
Will I feel better soon?
Yes. Rest, drink warm water, and you will be fine.
lines.ko: 네. 쉬고 따뜻한 물 마시면 괜찮아질 거예요.

lines.en: Grandma, I feel hot and tired.
Let me touch your head. You have a fever.
lines.ko: 이마 좀 만져 볼게요. 열이 있네요.

lines.en: Am I sick? Is it bad?
It's a small cold. You will be fine.
My head hurts a little.
Rest here on the sofa. I will bring cool water.
lines.ko: 여기 소파에서 쉬어요. 시원한 물 가져올게요.

lines.en: Thank you. Were you sick when you were little?
Yes. When I was sick, my mother cared for me.
lines.ko: 네. 아플 때 엄마가 저를 돌봐 주셨어요.

lines.en: Will you stay with me tonight?
lines.ko: 오늘 밤 저랑 같이 있어 줄 거예요?

lines.en: Sure. Sleep now, and maybe the fever will go.
lines.ko: 물론이죠. 이제 자요. 아마 열이 내릴 거예요.
